explication: PRFlow is an agentic coding plugin that turns a feature request into a review-ready GitHub pull request. The principal workflow is: specify and confirm an issue, implement on a branch with tests, run an iterative review-and-fix process with independent verification, synchronize documentation, and hand the PR to a developer for final merge. The tree strongly supports deterministic review, handoff validation, identity/configuration, and evidence tooling; several workflow stages are documented but represented only by their existing scripts directory.
